name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.32.4: a lease claim can be retried without taking a second machine. POST /api/v1/leases/claim accepts an optional requestId; the first call stores its result under that id and any later call with the same id returns the same serials (marked replayed) instead of claiming more. The new skraning.agvending.is Worker sends its registration id here, so a claim whose response was lost in transit is safe to repeat. Calls without requestId behave exactly as before. Cumulative over v6.32.3.
